input.title: ENH: DataFrame dtype keyword accept dict
input.body:
In IO functions (im thinking mostly read_csv) the `dtype` keyword accepts a dict.  We should allow the DataFrame dtype keyword to work the same way.

I think this came up briefly at a recent dev call.  IIRC @jorisvandenbossche suggested something like a `schema` keyword, but I'm fuzzy on this.
